where_the_rule_bites.summary: two product surfaces, opposite answers, both measured

where_the_rule_bites.honest_conclusion: The channel cap earns its place where a model states evidence status directly from rendered sources. Where a workflow already carries per-span provenance scoping, it is redundant. Both results are from the real product on the real corpus, and the negative is reported alongside the positive.
